description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source testing management system. It handles adding new test case scripts by interacting with code repositories, managing metadata for version control, and updating the database accordingly. The script also manages user interactions such as expanding/collapsing directory trees and creating new script links.

classes.name: tlCodeTracker
classes.description: A class managing code tracker interface interactions.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: A class representing test case entities and managing custom fields.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: Base class providing database access functions.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template rendering class used for output display.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: User class handling permissions and rights.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment parameters and user request arguments.

methods.name: getCodeTracker
methods.description: Retrieves code tracker configuration if enabled for the project.

methods.name: write_testcase_script
methods.description: Stores a new test case script link in the database after validating repository content.

methods.name: write_cfield_testscript
methods.description: Updates the custom field 'Test Script' for a test case if permitted.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the user has rights to modify test cases.
